v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Meetings outside work hours not accepted: 9:00 - 17:00
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Meetings v2_human 15:00 on a Friday, not allowed.
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Many other constraints similar and already specified in previous specification worksheet.

v2_human_g3_exception: No meetings on Saturday and Sunday. Mostly specified in previous specification sheet

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: System must not return any times for Friday v2_human 15:00 for a meeting.
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: System must not return any times for the meeting 8 during lunch: 12:00 - 13:00.
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The system shall only return time slots that are within work hours: 9:00 - 17:00.
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: The system shall only return time slots by which meeting ends a when working hours end and should not extend.

v2_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is to return time slots to the user, when inputted with Events list, meeting duration and date so that it outputs a list of available time slots for meeting.
v2_human_g3_input: events: List of dicts with keys. meeting_duration: int meeting length. day: String three letters to identify day.

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: Meetings cannot be held outside work hours: 9:00 - 17:00
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: Meetings cannot be held during lunch hours: 12:00 - 13:00

v2_human_g3_output: The function returns a list of available time slots for the meeting on that day.
v2_human_g3_tb: If two scenarios specify the same conditions/constraints then system must choose the earlier (first) time slot and output it.

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: All returned times must be in 'HH:MM' format.
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: Function should return start time only.
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: Meeting on Friday must not be held v2_human 15:00.
